update.releaseNotes:
v5.9.32 - Cold start reliability fix
Fixes --- - Team-home Career navigation no longer re-runs during character/scenario phases (fixes infinite Career hub tap loop) - Retries Career hub when character pick expected but still on team home - Switches to Home tab from Race tab before opening Career - Character roster scroll uses single OCR per row (bbox dedupe) and 1.5× OCR scale - Cold start reads trainee + scenario from active goal-queue patch when multi-run queue is enabled - Idle timeout resets to home navigation after prolonged stall on team home
Includes v5.9.31 support card optimizations and prior parent-farming fixes.
